An assignment planner using source identities, not a printable worksheet. Exercise text remains in the books. This frozen corpus follows the Indonesian edition source snapshot; the English interface does not assert coverage or numbering of other English editions. CLP1 has translated-file alignment only, not per-exercise target locations. Group/local numbers describe the source structure and need not equal printed numbering. A missing hint means none is recorded in this backend. No PDF page or HTML reader anchors are claimed.
